text: ONT | Physical connection at the ONT | Firmly reseat the fibre cable connector | | LOS light stays red after reseating cable | Fibre cut or upstream outage | Whether other customers nearby are also affected (informal signal of upstream outage) | Log a fault ticket — do not open the ONT casing | ### Escalation Logging a fault ticket is the documented next step once a firm cable connection doesn't clear the red LOS light, with an explicit instruction not to self-repair the ONT. ### Example Scenario **Customer situation:** A customer's home broadband ONT is showing a red LOS light and they're about to try opening the unit to check inside. **What happens:** The recommended step is only to confirm the fibre cable is firmly connected; if the light stays red, logging a fault ticket is the right next step rather than opening the ONT casing. ### Related Information Related documents referenced in NovaTel's internal metadata for this topic: KB_C25_overview. title: Why is my FTTH broadband connection showing 'LOS' (Loss of Signal) on the ONT?
